diagnostics.title: Missing icon alternative text
diagnostics.why: Icons require a textual equivalent for narration and nonvisual use.
diagnostics.fix: Add a short, meaningful alt component.

diagnostics.title: Invalid component specification
diagnostics.why: Unbounded or malformed presentation data is unsafe to render or synchronize.
diagnostics.fix: Provide a bounded localization key and fallback text.

diagnostics.title: Invalid component placeholder
diagnostics.why: Placeholder names and types must agree across locales and call sites.
diagnostics.fix: Declare each placeholder once with its canonical type.

diagnostics.title: Invalid stable identity
diagnostics.why: Persistence and references require an explicit, normalized namespaced id.
diagnostics.fix: Use a lowercase namespace:path id derived from the definition path.

diagnostics.title: Explicit id does not match its source path
diagnostics.why: A mismatch makes file renames and persisted identity ambiguous.
diagnostics.fix: Remove the explicit id or make it equal the path-derived id.

diagnostics.title: Invalid identity alias
diagnostics.why: Ambiguous, cyclic, or cross-kind aliases can corrupt reference migration.
diagnostics.fix: Use one acyclic same-kind old-id to new-id mapping.

diagnostics.title: Content-pack discovery failed
diagnostics.why: A pack root or source path could not be inspected safely.
diagnostics.fix: Use readable regular directories and files without symbolic links.

diagnostics.title: Invalid content-pack manifest
diagnostics.why: Pack identity, compatibility, dependencies, and policy must be known before definitions load.
diagnostics.fix: Correct pack.toml using the generated manifest schema.

diagnostics.title: Missing or incompatible pack dependency
diagnostics.why: Loading without a required compatible pack would leave unresolved content.
diagnostics.fix: Install a version matching the declared range or update the dependency declaration.

diagnostics.title: Content-pack dependency cycle
diagnostics.why: A deterministic load order cannot be produced from a dependency cycle.
diagnostics.fix: Remove one dependency edge and use explicit layered merge intent instead.

diagnostics.title: Content-pack identity collision
diagnostics.why: Two discovered packs cannot own the same stable pack identity.
diagnostics.fix: Assign one pack a distinct namespaced [pack].id.

diagnostics.title: Definition merge conflict
diagnostics.why: A collision without compatible explicit merge semantics would make load order ambiguous.
diagnostics.fix: Choose add, replace, merge, patch, or disable and satisfy that operation's preconditions.

diagnostics.title: Pack dependency contradicts precedence
diagnostics.why: A dependency cannot safely load first when its root tier or explicit priority says it must load later.
diagnostics.fix: Move the dependency to an equal/lower tier and priority, or raise the dependent pack's precedence.

diagnostics.title: Definition id is shared across kinds
diagnostics.why: Typed keys remain unambiguous, but identical ids across kinds make references and provenance harder to read.
diagnostics.fix: Give one definition a distinct path/id unless the shared spelling is deliberate.

diagnostics.title: No validated reload is staged
diagnostics.why: Publishing must use the exact snapshot that was reviewed during dry-run.
diagnostics.fix: Run /ps reload --dry-run, resolve errors, then publish that staged snapshot.

diagnostics.title: Staged reload is blocked
diagnostics.why: A snapshot containing structural errors cannot replace the live last-known-good registry.
diagnostics.fix: Run /ps validate, correct every error, and stage again.

diagnostics.title: Last-known-good recovery failed
diagnostics.why: Neither current content nor a verified recovery bundle could produce a safe live snapshot.
diagnostics.fix: Restore a valid pack source or a complete world backup and validate again.

diagnostics.title: Unsupported schema version
diagnostics.why: Definitions must compile through a known, versioned contract.
diagnostics.fix: Use schema_version = 2 or run an available migration.

diagnostics.title: Unknown schema field
diagnostics.why: Misspelled or future fields cannot be interpreted deterministically.
diagnostics.fix: Use a documented field name for this schema version.

diagnostics.title: Duplicate schema registration
diagnostics.why: Two owners cannot define the same schema identity safely.
diagnostics.fix: Keep one registration or assign a distinct namespaced id.

diagnostics.title: Invalid source span
diagnostics.why: Diagnostics and provenance must point to a valid bounded source range.
diagnostics.fix: Use a normalized relative source and a valid half-open line/column range.

diagnostics.title: Invalid canonical value
diagnostics.why: Canonical IR accepts only bounded typed values and immutable collections.
diagnostics.fix: Compile the field to its declared canonical value shape.

diagnostics.title: Invalid icon specification
diagnostics.why: Icon kinds, references, fallbacks, and preview policy must form one bounded descriptor.
diagnostics.fix: Use a documented icon kind with the required namespaced references and fallback.

diagnostics.title: Definition schema is not available
diagnostics.why: Accepting a definition before its typed compiler exists would create false validation claims.
diagnostics.fix: Use a definition kind implemented by this build or wait for its feature phase.

diagnostics.title: Unsafe presentation content
diagnostics.why: Commands, URLs, selectors, NBT, and other interpreted content cross trust boundaries.
diagnostics.fix: Use the bounded ComponentSpec subset only.

diagnostics.title: Malformed TOML source
diagnostics.why: Invalid TOML cannot compile into deterministic canonical data.
diagnostics.fix: Correct the reported file and field using a TOML-aware editor.

diagnostics.title: Content source exceeds a safety limit
diagnostics.why: Unbounded file counts, nesting, or bytes can exhaust server resources during reload.
diagnostics.fix: Split or reduce the pack so it stays within the documented hard ceilings.

diagnostics.title: Transaction state revision is stale
diagnostics.why: Applying a plan to a different state revision could duplicate costs, rewards, or ownership changes.
diagnostics.fix: Refresh the target state, rebuild the plan, and submit it with a new idempotency key.

diagnostics.title: Checked balance mutation was rejected
diagnostics.why: A debit, credit, bound, or checked-arithmetic operation could not commit safely.
diagnostics.fix: Correct the amount or affordability condition and rebuild the complete transaction plan.

diagnostics.title: Transaction definition generation is stale
diagnostics.why: A plan cannot execute after its pinned gameplay definitions or semantic digest change.
diagnostics.fix: Rebuild the plan against the current live definition generation.

diagnostics.title: Persistent lifecycle ownership is invalid
diagnostics.why: Conflicting resolvers or malformed ownership would make effective values nondeterministic.
diagnostics.fix: Use one registered resolver for every source contributing to the same entitlement.

diagnostics.title: Transition action was rejected or failed
diagnostics.why: Transition actions run only on explicit edges and must pass bounded physical-adapter validation.
diagnostics.fix: Correct the target, payload, delivery policy, or capacity issue and submit a fresh transaction.

diagnostics.title: Exact transaction ledger is full
diagnostics.why: A transaction cannot proceed without durable idempotency or receipt truth.
diagnostics.fix: Increase the configured hard capacity or complete the planned persistence/archive maintenance.

diagnostics.title: Persistent projection failed
diagnostics.why: The source-resolved value could not be applied atomically to its physical target.
diagnostics.fix: Inspect the target adapter and retry only with a newly validated transaction plan.

diagnostics.title: Transaction rollback is unavailable
diagnostics.why: Transition actions or later mutations cross the safe reversible boundary.
diagnostics.fix: Rollback only the latest retained action-free transaction or apply an explicit compensation.
